articles.title: Sophisticated US Government iPhone Hacking Tool 'Coruna' Leaked
articles.summary: A highly sophisticated iPhone hacking toolkit, dubbed 'Coruna,' allegedly developed for the US government, has been leaked. The toolkit reportedly contains five complete hacking techniques, raising concerns about its potential misuse and the security of iOS devices.

articles.title: New Rowhammer Attacks Give Complete Control of Machines Running Nvidia GPUs
